Data.title: Watch Out for the Newly Emerged Memecoin: BNB Developers Announce They Will File a Lawsuit
Data.body: BNB Chain has stated that it has no connection to the memecoin called ASTEROID, which was created by a former employee. The company said that the individual created a new private key using a seed phrase that they had unauthorized access to and issued tokens from the same wallet address. The story goes back to the previously launched TST token. According to BNB Chain, the former employee, while working at the company, created a new wallet address using the official test wallet to prepare a video tutorial, and launched the TST token through this address. It was stated that the employee, who continued to have unauthorized access to the relevant seed phrase after leaving the company, used this information to create a new private key. The same address was found to have been used on August 1st on BNB Chain to distribute a new meme coin called ASTEROID. Related News: How Did Bitcoin and Ethereum Perform in Past Augusts? Here Are the Key Statistics You Need to Know It was reported that the market value of the ASTEROID token briefly rose to $10 million within the first four hours of its launch. BNB Chain has clarified that the altcoin ASTEROID was not created, authorized, or promoted by the company. The company also stated that they do not control the token or its associated wallet address, and that the project is not supported by BNB Chain. The statement read, “BNB Chain did not participate in the creation of this token, nor did it authorize or endorse it. We have no control over the token or wallet address.” BNB Chain announced that it has initiated legal proceedings against the former employee and is cooperating with relevant public authorities regarding the matter. *This is not investment advice. Data.title: Pundit Claims This Move Would Push XRP Over $100,000, Top Analyst Says No Way
Data.body: A post from crypto commentator Pumpius (@pumpius) recently made the rounds on X. It claimed that a potential gold revaluation would push XRP above $100,000 as the USD loses value. The post received significant attention. ChartNerd, a technical analyst with a following in the XRP space, has seen enough. ChartNerd Responds ChartNerd (@ChartNerdTA) posted a clear rejection of the $100,000 claim. He told followers to “save yourself the disappointment and rid yourself of this type of mindless influencer garbage.” He warned that investors willing to follow such predictions would be “dragged through the floor for many years on false promises.” The response was firm. ChartNerd did not engage with the theory on its merits. He dismissed it outright and urged his audience to exercise judgment. $XRP will NOT hit $100,000 If i ever had to ask for one thing.. PLEASE, just save yourself the disappointment and rid yourself from this type of mindless influencer garbage. If you are willing to be dragged through the floor for many years on false promises, be my guest. https://t.co/ZQT5VmK2Dm — ChartNerd (@ChartNerdTA) July 31, 2026 Is $100,000 Realistic? ChartNerd has always been bullish on XRP, and has even called the $27 target inevitable . However, the math makes the target nearly impossible to justify. XRP currently trades around $1.08. A move to $100,000 would represent a gain of over 9,000,000%. XRP has approximately 57 billion tokens in circulation. At $100,000 per token, the market cap would reach $5.7 quadrillion. Global GDP sits at roughly $110 trillion. XRP at $100,000 would be worth more than 50 times the entire global economy. No asset in history has achieved anything close to that valuation. ChartNerd’s Track Record on Outlandish Targets ChartNerd has addressed inflated XRP predictions before. He recently called out Pumpius for outrageous targets . While that move was an error, as Pumpius was describing the amount he planned to invest, the recent exchange shows ChartNerd was heading in the right direction. His approach prioritizes technical structure over speculative targets. He has consistently separated himself from influencers who promote extreme price levels without credible technical or fundamental backing. We are on X, follow us to connect with us :- @TimesTabloid1 — TimesTabloid (@TimesTabloid1) June 15, 2025 The Pattern of Moonshot Calls ChartNerd is not the only voice pushing back. Jake Claver, chairman of Digital Ascension Group, predicted XRP would reach $100 before the end of 2025. XRP did not come close. Zach Rector, another analyst, publicly called the prediction misleading. TimesTabloid documented the pattern in January , listing invalidated predictions including Claver’s $750 target alongside calls from Chad Steingraber at $250, JackTheRippler at $100, and Time Traveler at $73,000. Claver has since said he is more bullish on XRP than ever , but community reaction has grown increasingly skeptical.
